name: @hjm/design-system-workspace
description: HJM design contracts and first-party React and React Native renderers.

scripts.check: pnpm -r --filter './packages/**' run check && pnpm bundle:renderer:check && pnpm workspace:check && pnpm evidence:check
scripts.bundle:check: pnpm build && pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts bundle:check && pnpm bundle:renderer:check
scripts.showcase:web: pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts build && pnpm --filter @hjm/react build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-web storybook
scripts.showcase:web:check: pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts build && pnpm --filter @hjm/react build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-web check
scripts.showcase:web:build: pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts build && pnpm --filter @hjm/react build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-web build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-web verify:static
scripts.showcase:native: pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts build && pnpm --filter @hjm/react-native build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-native storybook
scripts.showcase:native:ios: pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts build && pnpm --filter @hjm/react-native build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-native storybook:ios
scripts.showcase:native:check: pnpm --filter @hjm/design-contracts build && pnpm --filter @hjm/react-native build && pnpm --filter @hjm/showcase-native check
scripts.release:version: changeset version && pnpm install --lockfile-only && node scripts/sync-release-version.mjs && pnpm contracts:sync && pnpm build && pnpm evidence:sync
scripts.release:check: pnpm check && pnpm showcase:web:build && node scripts/check-release-artifacts.mjs
